state_transition_rules: idle may enter walk_step, guard_block, jab, knee, teep or hurt.
walk_step returns to idle with no pivot snap and can cancel into guard or jab only after a planted-foot frame.
attacks require startup/anticipation, active frame, follow-through and recovery before idle.
hurt preserves ground_y and returns through a recovery pose, never a direct scale snap.
